title: He Blocked My Spot For A Year. I Bought It.
script: Still in my spot? My condo came with an assigned parking space, painted number and all, and a neighbor's truck sat in it anyway for eleven months straight. He told the board he had always parked there before I bought the unit. Management mailed three written notices. He used them as kindling, apparently, because nothing changed. So I pulled the HOA bylaws and found the loophole: unused numbered spots could be bought outright from the association, and his own spot, two rows over, had sat empty the whole time. I bought it. Not his truck's spot, his actual spot, the one with his unit number stenciled on the curb, now legally mine. His truck got towed from both spaces in the same week, and he parks on the street now like the visitors he used to complain about. He left an angry note on my door. I taped it to the new sign. One stolen spot, one real one, and he is still guessing which curb is safe to touch?
